title: More community apps have a face
summary:
Hundreds of community apps gained screenshots, Weaver became Floret, and fixes addressed broken news paths and Klein gateway errors.

Screenshots were added to 762 app catalog entries and refreshed for seven more. The catalog also updated its request counts and Greenhouse listings, making the showcase easier to browse.

The multimodal creative agent was renamed Floret, including its OpenAI-compatible model ID, which changes from `weaver` to `floret`. Image, video, audio, and text generation behavior is otherwise unchanged.

Enter’s news banner and the website diary now use explicit news-branch URLs in place of paths that returned 404s. The README’s Latest News section was also refreshed with August 10 entries; it did not change the products covered there.

daily.title: More apps, more previews
daily.text: Hundreds more community apps now have screenshots in the catalog, so you can see what they’re making before you click. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
